institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

name: Pembrolizumab (adjuvant NSCLC checkpoint inhibitor)
supportiveCare: Adjuvant checkpoint-inhibitor completion of planned perioperative immunotherapy (about 1 year total).
Monitor for immune-related adverse events (thyroid, hepatic, colitis, pneumonitis, endocrine).

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 21 days to complete planned adjuvant checkpoint-inhibitor therapy after resection (up to about 1 year of total perioperative immunotherapy). 400 mg IV every 6 weeks is an accepted equivalent schedule. My own wording from standard perioperative NSCLC practice.
